extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: I'm pulling up the formulary for your county now.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans.

superlatives.text: The UnitedHealthcare plan available in Orange County has a $10 monthly premium, a $15 drug deductible and a $5900 maximum out-of-pocket.

composition.summary: The call was compliant with the CMS contract year 2027 marketing rules. The TPMO disclaimer was delivered and compliant with the ordering:before-benefits basis. The Scope of Appointment was collected before the benefits discussion, and the appointment was not scheduled. No superlatives were flagged.
composition.coaching_note: Agent: 'I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?' This is a good practice as it ensures the customer is aware of the appointment and can sign the document immediately, improving the customer experience.
